# HelpOne

> HelpOne (HelpOne Software, LLC, Somers, NY) is all-in-one nonprofit software: one login for volunteer management, event management, fundraising, donors & contacts (CRM), finances (GAAP-ready statements under ASC 958, fund accounting, Schedule B, fund balances and giving statements), HR, policies & procedures, training tracking, participants, board management and IT & software. One plan with every module: $299 a month, or $2,990 a year (two months free). 14-day free trial, no card. Unlimited users, volunteers, contacts, donors and events, with no per-seat or per-record fees.

Key facts (from this website):

- Tagline: "Your whole nonprofit. One login." Volunteers, donors, events, HR, finances and your board in one place, $299 a month with everything included. Start free trial: https://app.helponesoftware.com/demo. Book a demo: https://www.helponesoftware.com/contact-us.
- Typical cost of the separate tools HelpOne replaces (volunteer management, donor CRM, events, HR, e-signatures, scheduling, timesheets, IT tracking, background-check ordering, email and text outreach): about $1,500 a month on average for small and mid-size nonprofits (an estimate; costs vary).
- Cancelling: "No contracts. Cancel anytime in two clicks, and take your data with you." (from the Account page).
- Built exclusively for nonprofits; the platform is live.
- Pricing: one plan, HelpOne, $299/month or $2,990/year (two months free). Every module included: volunteers, donors & contacts, events, fundraising, finances, grants, HR & onboarding, e-signatures, timesheets, time off, training, policies, board, IT & software, calendar. Unlimited users, volunteers, contacts, donors and events; unlimited emails; 1,000 texts a month included (fair use, contact us for more). 14-day free trial, no card: when it ends, everything is saved and read-only until you choose a plan. No setup fees, no contracts, cancel anytime, export your data anytime. Start a trial at https://app.helponesoftware.com/demo; log in at https://app.helponesoftware.com.
- White label (HelpOne under your name, for associations, networks and consultants): contact us. See https://www.helponesoftware.com/white-label.
- Assistant: "Ask HelpOne" answers plain questions from your own data (only what your login can see); the "Daily brief" lists today's to-dos on the dashboard or by email at 7 AM.
- NYCON members: $249/month per organization or $2,490/year, plus free migration. Every module included; same 14-day free trial. Mention NYCON when you start, or email hello@helponesoftware.com, to claim the member rate.
- Payments: HelpOne Payments is coming soon and is not live yet. Planned pricing at launch: flat rate $1.75/transaction + $15/month when you bring your own processor, or interchange-plus (IC+) when HelpOne handles processing. When it launches, a HelpOne subscription will not be required to use HelpOne Payments.
- Security: AES-256 encryption; GDPR-aligned data practices; hashed passwords, rate-limited sign-in and optional Google sign-in (two-factor authentication is on the roadmap); automated security and tenant-isolation tests on every release.
- Onboarding: start with the 14-day free trial (no card), or book a demo and we'll walk you through it; most organizations are up and running within 2–4 weeks.
- Founder & CEO: Edward Zaremba. Strategic technology partner: Citinet Solutions.
- Memberships: New York Council of Nonprofits (NYCON), Nonprofit New York, Nonprofit Westchester, Business Council of Westchester.
- NYCON: HelpOne is a NYCON Corporate Partner.
- Element 46: HelpOne was selected for the Element 46 tech accelerator fall cohort (Westchester County, NY).
- Legal entity: HelpOne Software, LLC, Somers, NY.
- Contact: hello@helponesoftware.com (general), sales@helponesoftware.com (demos & sales), support@helponesoftware.com (support).

## Platform modules

- [Product](https://www.helponesoftware.com/product): Everything in HelpOne, module by module: the problem each one solves and what it does. All included in the one plan.
- [Volunteer Management](https://www.helponesoftware.com/volunteer-management): Online sign-up and waivers, shifts and waitlists, self check-in, and approved hours for your 990.
- [Event Management](https://www.helponesoftware.com/event-management): Free RSVPs with QR codes, tickets and gifts in each person's giving history, and event P&L.
- [Fundraising](https://www.helponesoftware.com/fundraising): Gifts, pledges, auctions and sponsorships, with company sponsors credited to the company.
- [Donors & Contacts](https://www.helponesoftware.com/donors-and-contacts): One record per person with giving and hours, notes and follow-ups, duplicate merge, and groups synced to Mailchimp.
- [Finances](https://www.helponesoftware.com/finances): GAAP-ready nonprofit financial statements under ASC 958 (financial position, activities by donor restriction, functional expenses, cash flows), with fund accounting, accruals and a locked, audited ledger, exportable to Excel and PDF. Set your own fiscal year; realized and unrealized investment gains; a check that catches older entries where a fund is out of balance; typeset PDFs of every statement, or all of them in one file, each with your organization's name, the fiscal period and page numbers. Trial balance and general ledger; editable chart of accounts with QuickBooks mapping; journal entries with supporting files and automatic reversal; each fund balances on its own; posted entries can't be edited (corrections are reversing entries) and only the owner can reopen a closed period, with a log; multi-year pledges at present value with an allowance and write-offs. Also gifts with benefits, Schedule B, Schedule G Part II, fund balances, deposits and giving statements. Includes an auto-filled Form 990.
- [HR Solutions](https://www.helponesoftware.com/hr-solutions): Onboarding documents with e-sign, reviews, time off and pay visibility limited to HR, the manager and the person.
- [Policies & Procedures](https://www.helponesoftware.com/policies-and-procedures): Policy books, approvals and signed copies.
- [Training Tracking](https://www.helponesoftware.com/training-tracking): Training assignments, reminders, completion certificates and overdue flags on the calendar.
- [Participants](https://www.helponesoftware.com/participants): The people you serve, in one list.
- [Board Management](https://www.helponesoftware.com/board-management): Board members, committees, meetings, documents, votes, conflict-of-interest compliance, tasks and a board member portal.
- [IT & Operations](https://www.helponesoftware.com/it-asset-tracking-management): Equipment and subscription tracking, plus operations: grants timesheets and budget vs actual, access groups, editable pick lists, Mailchimp sync.
- [My HelpOne](https://www.helponesoftware.com/my-helpone): Personal dashboard for staff: action items, events, calendar, timesheets and time-off requests.
- [Payments](https://www.helponesoftware.com/payments): Coming soon. Planned flat-rate or IC+ payment processing with QR codes, hosted pages and embeddable forms.
- [Switching to HelpOne Payments](https://www.helponesoftware.com/switching-to-helpone-payments): How switching payment processing to HelpOne will work once payments launch (coming soon).

## Pricing and getting started

- [Pricing](https://www.helponesoftware.com/pricing): One plan, $299/month or $2,990/year, every module, 14-day free trial.
- [White label](https://www.helponesoftware.com/white-label): HelpOne under your name for associations, networks and consultants.
- [Savings calculator](https://www.helponesoftware.com/calculator): Compare your current tools and fees with HelpOne.
- [NYCON members](https://www.helponesoftware.com/nycon): NYCON member rate for New York Council of Nonprofits members: $249/month per organization or $2,490/year, plus free migration.
- [Getting Started](https://www.helponesoftware.com/getting-started): Your first 14 days: the free trial, from setup to a real week of work.
- [Compare](https://www.helponesoftware.com/compare): HelpOne compared side by side with the tools nonprofits use today.
- [HelpOne vs Bloomerang](https://www.helponesoftware.com/helpone-vs-bloomerang): Pricing and features side by side, from both public pricing pages (Bloomerang CRM from $125/month billed annually, constituent-based; HelpOne $299/month flat; pricing as of Oct 2026, check their site).
- [Bloomerang alternative](https://www.helponesoftware.com/bloomerang-alternative): HelpOne and other Bloomerang alternatives, with published prices where companies list them.
- [Neon CRM alternative](https://www.helponesoftware.com/neon-crm-alternative): HelpOne and Neon CRM compared from Neon One's own pages (Neon CRM starts at $99/month, based on revenue; HelpOne $299/month flat). Pricing as of Oct 2026.
- [Little Green Light alternative](https://www.helponesoftware.com/little-green-light-alternative): HelpOne and Little Green Light compared from its pricing page (Little Green Light $45 to $135/month by constituent count; HelpOne $299/month flat). Pricing as of Oct 2026.
- [Salesforce nonprofit alternative](https://www.helponesoftware.com/salesforce-nonprofit-alternative): HelpOne and Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud and NPSP compared from Salesforce's own pages (Nonprofit Cloud Core from $70 per user per month, billed annually; HelpOne $299/month flat, unlimited users). Pricing as of Oct 2026.
- [Best donor management software for small nonprofits](https://www.helponesoftware.com/best-donor-management-software-small-nonprofits): A plain buyer's guide with a checklist and published prices by size for HelpOne, Little Green Light, Neon CRM, Bloomerang, Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, DonorPerfect and Virtuous, from each company's own pages. Pricing as of Oct 2026.
- [Virtuous alternative](https://www.helponesoftware.com/virtuous-alternative): HelpOne and Virtuous compared from Virtuous's own pages. Virtuous doesn't publish prices; HelpOne is $299/month flat with every module. Pricing as of Oct 2026.
- [Best volunteer management software for nonprofits](https://www.helponesoftware.com/best-volunteer-management-software-nonprofits): A plain buyer's guide with a checklist and published starting prices for Bloomerang Volunteer, Neon CRM, Galaxy Digital, VolunteerHub, Better Impact and Track it Forward, plus where HelpOne fits. Pricing as of Oct 2026.
- [FAQ](https://www.helponesoftware.com/faq): Common questions about pricing, payments, features and security.
- [Security](https://www.helponesoftware.com/security): Plain-English security and compliance overview.
